title: Folded Iron
body:
# Craft, Mine, Fight, Repeat

Folded Iorn is a weapon bassed mod that focases on diffculty scaling and bosses that make you wanna pull out your hair becuase they keep on spaming their moves

# How to play:

read the discriptions, they contain all the information you need for a casual playthrough,
also experement! in this mod I want you to use multible weapons to create fantasitc combos and explore fun synergies (yes this mod has those)

enjoy stunning your foes before wailing on them at full force, or, take a safer aprouch and heal and buff up. It's up to you to find a way to conqure this mods challenges!

# Inportant information:

this mod gets more difficult at higher difficulties yes, however at the same time some items get stronger as well, along with that you also unlock more itmes at higher difficulties with hard mode drops, so, play it safe and experiance a fraction of this mod and keep your sanity, or,  challenge yourself and **become the boss**.

It's up to you how you play so, have fun! play on the easiest difficulty for all I care so long as you are enjoying this mod that's all that matters.

# recemendations

it is recommended that you play this mod with any health bar mod that replaces the vinnala health bar with eather a number or an actual bar, otherwise half your screen will be nothing but hearts
